edits.before: Luden's/Stormsurge spike: the stun-burst math kills through Doran's defenses. Stock, walk forward, win.
edits.after: Her first item outpaces yours in poke: spheres chip you off the wave before your burst threshold arrives.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Check it before every step-up. - E Molten Shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is 15s flat at every rank and needs a sphere on the line — the second she pushes one out and misses, step up. - Force of Will is 12s at rank 1 and carries her slow. - Molten Shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry by punishing setup: she needs a sphere placed before Scatter the Weak stuns — step in on the whiff and Flash-Tibbers.

edits.before: If Syndra takes first blood, tighten up: Scatter the Weak (Stun) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Syndra takes first blood her Unleashed Power threshold arrives early — track your HP number, not the bar, and stay above it. Farm with Q refunds, hold the glow, and let her spend Scatter the Weak on the wave before you step.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Syndra off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, hold the glow just outside her sphere line, take CS in the 15s after Scatter the Weak misses, and Flash-Tibbers her recovery step.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's or Stormsurge into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — cast it mid-Tibbers.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame. Her upgraded W deals true damage — buy Zhonya's, not MR; cast it mid-Tibbers.

edits.before: Her Unleashed Power one-shot threat check is the scariest moment in the matchup, but if you can survive to level 6 yourself your own Tibbers threat starts giving her pause about overextending.
edits.after: Her Unleashed Power executes you outright under a health threshold, so from 6 track the number rather than the bar; survive it and your own Tibbers threat starts giving her pause about overextending.

edits.before: Level 6 is the highest-danger point since her Unleashed Power can delete you in one rotation, but if you survive it your own Tibbers threat starts to matter and gives her a reason to respect your space instead of just poking freely.
edits.after: Level 6 is the highest-danger point since Unleashed Power executes you below its threshold, so disengage the moment you dip there, but if you survive it your own Tibbers threat starts to matter and gives her a reason to respect your space.
